findings.title: Resolve relative executable paths against the approved plugin root before spawning
findings.trigger: A build or action declares a relative program path such as ./bin/action.exe and Crew is invoked outside the plugin root.
findings.impact: Program resolution depends on OS-specific Command behavior rather than the approved plugin root. Windows can fail to find the intended program or resolve a same-named caller-directory file.
findings.expected: Resolve explicit relative program paths to an absolute path rooted at the plugin directory for both build and action commands; keep bare executable names using PATH.
findings.evidence_kind: static code plus official Rust Command::current_dir contract; Windows native reproduction NOT_RUN

findings.title: A stale disabled development link must not hide healthy plugins from action discovery
findings.trigger: Install crew.workspaces, link a local plugin with --disabled, edit that linked manifest, then run plugin action list --json.
findings.impact: The global action list exits 1 with empty stdout because store::loaded(entry)? aborts the whole list. A qualified crew.workspaces listing still returns all three healthy actions.
findings.expected: Report unavailable/stale plugin diagnostics per entry while retaining healthy action records; keep invocation refusal for stale manifests.
findings.evidence_kind: actual immutable candidate binary and temporary local profiles, exit codes and output retained
